title: Juicy Peruvian Roquito Relleno
description: A Peruvian dish featuring a crunchy romano pepper exterior and a flavorful beef and rice filling. A comforting and satisfying meal.
instructions: Cut the tops off the romano peppers and scoop out the seeds and membranes.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the cooked rice, beef broth, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stuff each romano pepper with the beef and rice mixture, filling them as full as possible.
Place the stuffed peppers in a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake the peppers for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and top each pepper with shredded cheese.
Return the peppers to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the peppers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
If using, drizzle the rendered beef fat over the top of each pepper before serving.
